facts.fact: Minister Frederic Nze chaired the launch in Brazzaville of the technical committee drafting the national AI strategy, supported by UNDP, with six months to produce eleven deliverables.

COG.note: A budget of 150-200 million FCFA is said to be needed, not allocated; the committee writes the strategy, so no body is recorded.
No model, dataset or AI computing stated.
